fields.description: File magic 'SCJ2' (title initials). Visible only in the rev8 logical domain at offset 0x00.
fields.evidence: Baseline logical bytes 0x00-0x03 read 53 43 4A 32 ('SCJ2'); raw bytes are bit-reversed per 8-byte word, so eeprom_rev8=true with FUN_0813a204 8-byte word transfers grounds the logical domain.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Second header word (0x72A2B9C3). Purpose unknown: it does not match the FUN_0813454c hash over any probed range. Preserved verbatim.
fields.evidence: Stable u32_le at logical offset 0x04 following save_magic; probed against FUN_0813454c rotl23-add hash over record, header, and checksum ranges with no match.
fields.name: header_tag

fields.description: Slot 0 primary word 0 (0x08263F00, falls in ROM address space). Exact gameplay role unknown; preserved verbatim as a mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: FUN_08134570 writes 8 EEPROM words per 64-byte record (primary at slot*8+1, backup at (slot+3)*8+1); FUN_081345d0 reads them back; value verified in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x08-0x0B.
fields.name: slot0_w0

fields.description: Slot 0 primary word 1 (0x08263FCC, ROM address space, 0xCC above word 0). Role unknown; mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: Same 8-word record transfer as slot0_w0 via FUN_08134570/FUN_081345d0; value verified in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x0C-0x0F.
fields.name: slot0_w1

fields.description: Slot 0 primary word 2 (0x08135A95, odd ROM address typical of Thumb code). Role unknown; mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: Same 8-word record transfer as slot0_w0 via FUN_08134570/FUN_081345d0; value verified in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x10-0x13.
fields.name: slot0_w2

fields.name: slot0_w3

fields.description: Slot 0 primary word 4 (0x03007DA0, IWRAM, 4 above word 3). Role unknown; mutable scalar for live probing.

fields.name: slot0_w4

fields.name: slot0_w5

fields.name: slot0_w7

fields.description: Slot 0 primary zero gap (16 bytes). Matches the default-init path that zero-fills the RAM record struct.
fields.evidence: All-zero in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x28-0x37; FUN_08134c98 zero-fills the 0x3C-byte default record struct before first write via FUN_08134570.
fields.name: slot0_reserved

fields.description: Slot 0 primary record checksum (0xBC026DB9): FUN_0813454c rotl23-add hash over the 48 record bytes, stored at record+0x30. Custom algorithm, so no checksums[] entry.
fields.evidence: FUN_0813454c computes u=(rotl(u,23)+byte) over 0x30 bytes and FUN_08134570 stores it at buf+0x30; Python recomputation over baseline.sav logical bytes [0x08,0x38) equals 0xBC026DB9 at 0x38.
fields.name: slot0_checksum

fields.description: Slot 0 primary 4-byte zero gap between checksum and tag word.
fields.evidence: All-zero in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x3C-0x3F inside the 64-byte record written by FUN_08134570.
fields.name: slot0_pad

fields.description: Slot 0 primary tag word (480 = 0x1E0). Meaning unknown; preserved verbatim as a mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: Trailing record word written by the FUN_08134570 8-word transfer; value 480 verified in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x40-0x43.
fields.name: slot0_tag

fields.description: Slot 0 primary address word (0x08121B64, ROM address space). Meaning unknown; preserved verbatim as a mutable scalar for live probing.
fields.evidence: Trailing record word written by the FUN_08134570 8-word transfer; value verified in baseline.sav logical bytes 0x44-0x47.
fields.name: slot0_addr

fields.description: Slot 1 primary 64-byte record (byte-identical to slot 0 primary in this baseline). Paired with slot1_backup.
fields.evidence: FUN_08134570 writes slot records at (slot*3)*8+1 words (slot 1 at file 0x48); FUN_081345d0 reads them back; FUN_0813466c initializes slots 0, 1 and 2.
fields.name: slot1_record
